final: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_invoices, AVG(invoice_count * 1.0 / total_invoices) AS average_share, AVG(invoice_count * 1.0 / total_invoices - average_share) AS average_excess FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(invoice_number) AS invoice_count, SUM(COUNT(invoice_number)) OVER () AS total_invoices, AVG(COUNT(invoice_number) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(invoice_number)) OVER ()) OVER () AS average_share FROM Orders LEFT JOIN Invoices USING (order_id) GROUP BY order_id) WHERE invoice_count * 1.0 / total_invoices > average_share
